title.en: Austin new-restaurant watch: oysters, bakeries, sushi, and Thai food
title.zh: 奥斯汀新餐厅观察：生蚝、烘焙、寿司与泰餐

excerpt.en: Eater Austin's May 2026 heatmap gives local diners a concrete weekend shortlist: seafood in Holly, bakeries downtown and on South Lamar, sushi on Rainey, and Thai food on South Lamar.
excerpt.zh: Eater Austin 2026 年 5 月新餐厅地图给本地读者一份实用周末清单：Holly 的海鲜、Downtown 与 South Lamar 的烘焙、Rainey 的寿司，以及 South Lamar 的泰餐。

body.en: The latest Eater Austin heatmap adds Austin Oyster Co., Sugarwolf, Ciccio Bomba, and Kinsho. For ChineseAustin readers, that means a quick scan of where to book, pick up pastries, or meet friends before a weekend plan gets crowded.
body.zh: 最新 Eater Austin 新餐厅地图加入 Austin Oyster Co.、Sugarwolf、Ciccio Bomba 与 Kinsho。对 ChineseAustin 读者来说，这是一份可快速判断订位、买点心或约朋友聚餐的本地清单。

body.en: The wider list is useful for Asian-food-adjacent plans too: Kappo Kappo and Shokunin cover higher-end Japanese counters, Kiin Di gives South Lamar a Thai option, and Leona adds a Sunset Valley cafe stop.
body.zh: 完整清单也适合安排亚洲餐饮相关行程：Kappo Kappo 与 Shokunin 提供较高端的日式吧台选择，Kiin Di 是 South Lamar 的泰餐点，Leona 则补上 Sunset Valley 的咖啡餐厅。

body.en: Check the linked guide and restaurant sites before going. Hours, reservations, waits, and opening menus shift quickly, especially for new downtown, South Lamar, Holly, and Rainey Street spots.
body.zh: 出发前请先查看来源指南与餐厅官网。新店的营业时间、订位、排队状况与开业菜单变化很快，尤其是 Downtown、South Lamar、Holly 和 Rainey Street 一带。

title.en: Austin civic watch: housing, transit, and city-service notices
title.zh: 奥斯汀市政观察：住房、交通与城市服务通知

excerpt.en: Austin Monitor and City of Austin notices help residents track council, housing, mobility, utilities, and public meetings before a deadline slips by.
excerpt.zh: Austin Monitor 与奥斯汀市政府通知能帮助居民在期限前掌握市议会、住房、交通、公用事业与公开会议资讯。

body.en: For Austin families, renters, students, and small-business owners, civic news usually matters when it changes a route, fee, permit, hearing date, or neighborhood plan.
body.zh: 对奥斯汀家庭、租客、学生和小商家来说，市政新闻真正重要的时候，往往是它改变路线、费用、许可、听证日期或社区规划。

body.en: Austin Monitor is useful for City Council, land-use, housing, mobility, and board decisions. The City of Austin news page is where readers can confirm official notices, public meetings, safety updates, and service changes.
body.zh: Austin Monitor 适合追踪市议会、土地使用、住房、交通与委员会决定。奥斯汀市政府新闻页则可核对官方通知、公开会议、安全更新与服务变化。

body.en: Before acting on a rumor or neighborhood post, use the linked sources to confirm what changed, who is affected, and whether there is a comment window, signup, or deadline.
body.zh: 在根据传闻或社区帖子采取行动前，先用这些来源确认发生了什么、谁受影响，以及是否有公开意见期、报名表或截止日期。

title.en: Where Austin Chinese families can find community resources
title.zh: 奥斯汀华人家庭可以从这些社区资源开始

excerpt.en: Texas Capital News, Austin's Asian American Resource Center, and the Greater Austin Asian Chamber give readers a grounded starting point for events, services, and business networks.
excerpt.zh: 《德州首府新闻》、奥斯汀亚裔资源中心与 Greater Austin Asian Chamber 可作为读者查找活动、服务与商业网络的本地起点。

body.en: Austin's Chinese community is spread across UT, Northwest Austin, Cedar Park, Round Rock, and other Central Texas suburbs. A useful reader guide starts with sources that actually serve those places.
body.zh: 奥斯汀华人社区分布在 UT、Northwest Austin、Cedar Park、Round Rock 与其他中德州郊区。有用的读者指南应从真正服务这些地方的来源开始。

body.en: Texas Capital News helps with Chinese-language community context. The Asian American Resource Center offers city-backed cultural programming, events, and service connections for Asian American families.
body.zh: 《德州首府新闻》提供中文社区脉络。Asian American Resource Center 则提供由市府支持的文化项目、活动与亚裔家庭服务连接。

body.en: For owners, founders, and professionals, the Greater Austin Asian Chamber adds a business network. Pair these links with Chinese schools, faith groups, and local calendars when planning next steps.
body.zh: 对商家、创业者与专业人士来说，Greater Austin Asian Chamber 补上商业网络。安排下一步时，可把这些连结与中文学校、信仰团体及本地日历一起查看。

title.en: Austin travel and campus notices for families and students
title.zh: 面向家庭与学生的奥斯汀出行和校园通知

excerpt.en: AUS, UT Austin, and KUT updates help families plan airport pickups, move-ins, campus changes, weather, utilities, and local transportation.
excerpt.zh: AUS、UT Austin 与 KUT 的更新可帮助家庭安排机场接送、搬家入学、校园变化、天气、公用事业与本地交通。

body.en: Austin-Bergstrom updates matter when parents are flying in, students are moving, or relatives need a ride across town. Check the airport newsroom for construction, route, parking, and traveler advisories.
body.zh: 家长来访、学生搬家或亲友需要跨城接送时，Austin-Bergstrom 的更新很关键。请查看机场新闻室，确认施工、航线、停车与旅客提醒。

body.en: UT Austin News covers campus calendars, research, safety, and student-life changes. KUT is useful for explaining local issues like schools, transportation, utilities, and weather impacts.
body.zh: UT Austin News 覆盖校园日历、研究、安全与学生生活变化。KUT 则适合了解学校、交通、公用事业与天气影响等本地议题。

body.en: Use these links before booking travel, arranging pickup windows, or helping a new student settle in. They are the local sources most likely to catch practical changes first.
body.zh: 订票、安排接送时间或协助新生安顿前，先查看这些连结。它们最有可能先发布会影响实际安排的本地变化。
